title: Signal Classifier and Error Slice Dashboard for Inference Pathways
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a signal classifier and a set of error-slice dashboards that surface root causes across the inference stack (client, routing, runtime, model, network). The goal is to make it fast for oncall and platform engineers to diagnose production degradations by slicing errors and latency by clear failure facets (timeout, overload, model-runtime, protocol errors, validation/error-code mapping). This work ties tracing hooks, metrics/log ingestion, and the dashboard UX into a coherent troubleshooting flow.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A classifier runs on ingested traces/metrics and tags requests with a primary failure facet and up to two secondary facets. 2) Dashboard provides interactive slices: per-route, per-model, per-region, per-backend-version, and per-failure-facet with time-series and distribution (p99/p95/p50) views. 3) Chart drilldowns link to example traces and the canonical PR/KB for handling each facet. 4) Alert rule templates published for high-rate occurrences of individual facets. 5) End-to-end tests validate classifier precision >=70% on historical labelled incidents and dashboards reflect that labelling.
success_metrics:
- Mean time to diagnose (MTTD) for P1 inference incidents reduced by 30% in six weeks.
- Classifier precision >=70% and recall >=60% on recent incident corpus.
- Dashboards used in at least 80% of post-incident writeups for inference regressions.
tasks: Add minimal tracing hook to runtime to emit failure-reason tags and latency buckets
Implement classifier job in observability pipeline (rules + deterministic heuristics)
Create error-slice dashboard panels in Console (heatmap, stacked-rate, latency quantiles, example-traces)
Instrument sampling rules so traces surface representative failure types
Write alert templates and playbook entries for top 5 facets
